name: Whip
overview: The Scriptures use the imagery of the whip to convey discipline, authority, and judgment. In 1 Kings 12:11, the whip symbolizes harsh chastisement, reflecting the severity of the yoke imposed by a ruler. Proverbs 26:3 illustrates the whip as an instrument of correction for stubbornness or folly, emphasizing its role in guiding behavior. Additionally, Nahum 3:2 uses the sound of the whip to evoke the intensity and power associated with chariots in battle, highlighting its association with strength and control.
